mechanism: From synced OBJ_TREND anchors (T1,P1),(T2,P2): slope=(P2-P1)/(T2-T1); trend_price=P1+slope*(TimeCurrent()-T1). Compare live BID to trend_price with tolerance: approach (within zone), touch (|bid-trend_price|≤tol), breakout above/below, rejection (approach then reverse without cross). Per-line state stored in TrendlineInfo; OnTick evaluates every synced line.

mechanism: Synced OBJ_HLINE support/resistance: currentSide=(bid<level)?1:(bid>level)?-1:0. Breakout when lastSide≠0 and currentSide≠0 and currentSide≠lastSide; breakoutDirection from prevValidSide. Retest only if DetectRetest && breakoutHappened && distance≤touchTol, then clear breakoutHappened. Reversal if touched && currentSide==sideBeforeTouch && !breakoutAlerted. Approach/touch flags reset when distance>approachTol.

mechanism: State from RSI vs InpOverbought/InpOversold → OVERBOUGHT/OVERSOLD/NEUTRAL. Strength from slope=rsi−prevRSI: in OB, rsi≥80→EXTREME SELL; slope<−1.5→STRONG SELL; slope>0→WEAK SELL; else SELL. Mirror in OS (rsi≤20 EXTREME BUY; slope>1.5 STRONG BUY; slope<0 WEAK BUY). Neutral→NEUTRAL. Panel anchors to Bid/Ask via ChartTimePriceToXY.

mechanism: FindThreeBarMove impulsive pole if cumulative 3-bar move ≥ MinPoleATR×ATR(20). Forward consolidation must retrace ≤ MaxRetracePercent of pole (default 61.8%), last MinFlagBars..MaxFlagBars, with internal pullback/push counts. Bull flag: downward/sideways channel after up-pole; bear: upward/sideways after down-pole. Confirm on breakout beyond channel; draw pole, slanted channel, shaded zone, arrow. Dual-phase: full historical scan then incremental activeFlags updates.
